description: Plain modern CSS (nesting, custom properties), no extra dependencies
agents: Styles: plain CSS. Entry `src/app/styles/styles.css`, passed through YASSB's compiler as CSS: nesting, custom properties and `@layer` stay as they are, the output is minified. Keep the styles in this one file: an `@import` of another CSS file stays a request made by the browser (put such files in `src/assets/`).
